Name: Maid Cafe
Author: FQYWxun
Description:
[b][size=5]Maid Cafe[/size][/b]
[size=4]v0.11.0[/size]


[size=4][b]What's new in 0.11.0[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]One package, three portrait styles.[/b] Both portrait sets now ship in the same zip, and the style is a setting: OhoDavi style / vanilla style / follow your own portrait mod (default = vanilla). No dependency on any other mod, and your current save is fine.[/*]
[*][b]The text problems are fixed for good.[/b] Characters the game font cannot draw (stars, arrows, quotes) used to show up as asterisks or empty boxes - they fall back to readable equivalents now. Night reports and ledgers are stored as data and rendered when shown, so switching language no longer leaves the old language (or boxes) behind in a panel.[/*]
[*][b]The starter letter is finally wired up.[/b] The day after your cafe is finished you now get Lanxi's starter letter together with the handbook letter: a drink machine, coffee beans, a tea sapling, tea leaves, ready-made coffee and green tea, and a bottle of wine - plus you learn the drink machine recipe. [b]If your cafe is already built, you receive this letter once, retroactively.[/b][/*]
[*]Abigail's vanilla-style portrait had a checkerboard background baked into the image; it is cut out now.[/*]
[*]Robin / Pam / Haley / Jodi each got the overtime closing line they were missing in the night summary.[/*]
[/list]
Build a cafe on your farm, hire the valley's girls as waitresses, and run the evening service. Ten villagers can be hired, each with her own lines, her own level curve and her own way of spending a night out.

[b][color=orange]An apology to everyone who played an earlier build in English[/color][/b]
Those builds showed a lot of garbled boxes instead of readable text — punctuation left over from the Chinese tables, a panel that never translated its skill descriptions, and text that ran off the edge instead of wrapping. [b]0.10.0 fixed the layout, and 0.11.0 cleaned up the last of it[/b]: the English strings are clean, long text wraps inside its panel, characters the game font cannot draw no longer turn into asterisks or boxes, and reports re-render in whatever language you are playing. Sorry for the mess.

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Build the cafe[/b] — Robin's build menu, 30,000g + 150 wood + 20 cloth, 2 days. It comes with its own interior map.[/*]
[*][b]Hire the staff[/b] — craft a [b]Hire Contract[/b] (2 cloth + 10 wood) and give it to any female villager you have at least [b]4 hearts[/b] with.[/*]
[*][b]Open for business[/b] — 4 PM to midnight. Walk up to the [b]berry-red bar counter along the back wall[/b] and click it (any tile of the counter works). That same menu holds [b]Stock the bar[/b], [b]Close for the night[/b] and the [b]Books[/b]. The game pauses while you are in the cafe.[/*]
[*][b]Assign waitresses[/b] — guests are male villagers. You pair each guest with a maid; anyone you skip is served by you (the owner) personally.[/*]
[*][b]Watch the service[/b] — each maid walks to the table and talks over the head bubble, with different lines per outcome (and per maid).[/*]
[*][b]Four outcomes[/b] — Poor / Normal / Good / Excellent. A Poor night costs you money but is very rare; Good and Excellent can earn a gift picked from the guest's real vanilla gift tastes.[/*]
[*][b]Make your own drinks[/b] — craft the [b]Drink Machine[/b] (30 wood + 20 stone + 5 clay + 1 copper bar), drop [b]5 coffee beans[/b] in and it gives you [b]5 cups of coffee[/b]; tea leaves turn into green tea the same way. Each drink also carries a small buff of its own.[/*]
[*][b]Stock the bar and take orders[/b] — the bar shelf is a 20-slot storage box: put those drinks (or a bottle of wine) in it, one item per slot. When a guest is happy he may order a drink — guests reach for what they actually like, so keeping the right stock in is worth real money, and wine is what loosens a guest up.[/*]
[*][b]Wine[/b] — real bottles, flavour included (blueberry wine, mead, pale ale...). Never served to minors, and a guest who has been drinking is far more likely to ask for overtime.[/*]
[*][b]Overtime & identity variants[/b] — a very happy guest may ask the maid to stay longer. With adult content [b]off[/b], every maid does this her own way: Tea Talk, Stargazing, Photos, Cooking Lesson, Finishing Up... each with her own pay, her own stamina cost and her own odds of bringing something back. Jas (the youngest maid) gets a clean "Playtime" instead — she plays with the guest in the back room, earns no money and never gets tired.[/*]
[*][b]Skills[/b] — every maid has three perks, unlocked at skill level 4 / 7 / 10. Some serve, some manage the shop when you let her run a night for you.[/*]
[*][b]Declining is fine[/b] — say no to a request and she takes it in stride (she even gets a line about it in the night summary). It is your shop.[/*]
[*][b]Growth[/b] — maids gain skill levels and friendship with you; both you and the guest gain friendship with each other.[/*]
[*][b]Hidden affinity[/b] — each maid quietly builds familiarity with each guest. Regulars come back more often and ask for the maid they remember.[/*]
[*][b]Maid Handbook[/b] — mailed to you the day after the cafe opens (also craftable). Hold it and right-click: every maid's level, experience, stamina, skills, service count, who she is closest to, and the regulars who keep asking for her.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 (tested)[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later (tested 4.5.1)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9 or later (tested 2.9.1)[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — lets you change everything in-game (nothing is locked behind it; config.json works just as well)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Two builds[/b][/size]
Both portrait sets ship in the same download; the style is a setting in the mod options (three choices, default = vanilla). Switching takes effect the next time you open a menu.
[list]
[*][b]Vanilla style (default)[/b] — our vanilla-based maid outfits plus the game's own guest portraits (35 portraits)[/*]
[*][b]OhoDavi style[/b] — the ohodavi-style set: redrawn maid outfits plus his 22 guest portraits (35 portraits)[/*]
[*][b]Follow your own portrait mod[/b] — nothing is replaced; menus use whatever portrait mod you already have[/*]
[/list]Both packs contain [b]MaidCafe[/b], [b]MaidCafe.Content[/b] and [b]MaidCafe.MapPatch[/b].
Adult content is included in [b]both[/b] builds and is [b]off by default[/b].

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/*]
[*]Unzip and drop [b]MaidCafe[/b], [b]MaidCafe.Content[/b] and [b]MaidCafe.MapPatch[/b] into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI once; a [b]config.json[/b] is created inside [b]Mods/MaidCafe[/b].[/*]
[*]Updating from 0.10.0 or 0.9.0: just overwrite. Saves are compatible — anything left on the old shelf moves into the new 20-slot stock on first use, nothing is lost. If your cafe is already built, you receive the starter letter once, retroactively.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
Everything is adjustable in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (or config.json). Notable defaults:
[list]
[*]Recruiting: at least [b]4 hearts[/b]; [b]Evelyn[/b] is excluded by default (edit the list if you want her)[/*]
[*]Hours: [b]4 PM – 12 AM[/b]; [b]3 rounds[/b] per night, 2 hours each[/*]
[*]Guests: [b]2–3[/b] per round, +1 for every 3 hired maids[/*]
[*]Outcome odds (level 1): usually Normal, occasionally Good, Excellent is uncommon, Poor is under 1%[/*]
[*]Money: 60g base + 15g per maid level, ×0.5 / 1.0 / 1.3 / 1.7 by outcome[/*]
[*]Gifts: Good 45%, Excellent 75% (40% of those are the guest's loved gift)[/*]
[*]Overtime: 25% chance on an Excellent result, at most 2 per night, ×4 gold and ×3 experience — and per-maid pay, stamina and gift odds as listed above[/*]
[*]Friendship: +4 with the maid and +3 with the guest per service[/*]
[*]Adult content: [b]off by default[/b]; when on, it needs [b]4 hearts[/b] with the maid[/*]
[/list][b]Note for existing saves:[/b] your old config.json keeps its old values — nothing overwrites it. Use "reset to default" in GMCM if you want the new numbers.

[size=4][b]Content notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The adult layer is [b]suggestive text only[/b] — no explicit content, no explicit art. It is off by default.[/*]
[*]Minor characters (Vincent, Jas, Leo) are hard-excluded in code from any adult content.[/*]
[*]The interior art is a [b]placeholder[/b] (generated), and will be replaced with hand-drawn art later.[/*]
[*]Guests stand in front of their chairs — vanilla NPCs have no sitting sprites.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Interior is a placeholder map (its own map file, geometry already final).[/*]
[*]Guests do not sit.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Code, data, English and Chinese text: Lanxi[/*]
[*]The vanilla-style maid portraits are our own redraw based on the game's portraits; the OhoDavi-style maid portraits are redrawn in the artist's style (credit below)[/*]
[*]Portrait art based on [b]"stardewvalley anime mods" by OhoDavi[/b] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Nexus mod 1839[/url]), used with credit as permitted by the author[/*]
[*]The vanilla-style guest portraits are crops of the game's own portraits; the 22 OhoDavi-style guest portraits are the artist's original work[/*]
[*]Built on SMAPI and Content Patcher by Pathoschild[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Found a bug?[/b][/size]
Please post the SMAPI log (smapi.io/log) — it says exactly which part complained. Chinese and English reports are both fine.


[b]女仆咖啡厅 Maid Cafe[/b]　
[code]v0.11.0[/code][b]0.11.0 更新了什么[/b]
[list]
[*][b]一个包，三种头像风格[/b]：两套头像都装进同一个压缩包，风格在模组设置里三选一 —— [b]①OhoDavi 风格 / ②游戏原版风格（默认）/ ③跟随你自己的美化包[/b]。不依赖任何前置，老存档直接兼容。[/*]
[*][b]文字乱码这次真的清干净了[/b]：字体画不出来的字符（星号、箭头、引号）以前会显示成*或方框，现在会回退成能读的写法；结算与账本改成[b]存数据、显示时才渲染[/b]，切语言不会再在面板里留下旧语言或方框。[/*]
[*][b]开业启动包终于接上线了[/b]：咖啡厅落成的[b]第二天[/b]，你会和《女仆手册》的信一起收到澜汐的启动包（一台调饮机、咖啡豆、茶苗、茶叶、现成的咖啡与绿茶、一瓶果酒），并[b]一并学会调饮机配方[/b]。[b]已经建好咖啡厅的旧存档会补发一次这封信。[/b][/*]
[*]原版档 Abigail 头像里烘焙进去的棋盘格底已抠掉；Robin / Pam / Haley / Jodi 补上了加钟结算里缺的那句收尾词。[/*]
[/list]在你的农场开一家咖啡厅，把村里的姑娘雇来当女仆，招待傍晚进店的客人。可招募的女仆有十位，每人都有自己的台词、自己的成长曲线和自己过一晚的方式。
[b]先向之前用英文玩过的朋友道歉[/b]：旧版本的英文界面会出现大量方框乱码（英文表里残留了中文标点、技能描述整段没翻译、文字放不下会冲出面板）。0.10.0 修好了排版，[b]0.11.0 把"字体缺字"和"切语言后残留旧语言"这两类也一起清干净了[/b] —— 字体画不出来的字符会回退成能读的写法，结算与账本改成显示时才渲染。给大家添麻烦了。
[b]玩法[/b]
[list]
[*][b]盖店[/b]：Robin 的建造菜单里有「女仆咖啡厅」，30,000g + 木材 150 + 布料 20，工期 2 天，自带专属室内地图。[/*]
[*][b]招人[/b]：做一份「聘用合同」（布料 2 + 木材 10），送给好感 ≥[b]4 心[/b]的女性村民。[/*]
[*][b]营业[/b]：傍晚 16 点到 24 点。走到[b]店里最里面那排莓红色吧台[/b]前点一下（吧台任意一格都行）就能开《咖啡厅菜单》——[b]营业 / 打烊 / 备货上架 / 账本总览[/b]都在这一张菜单里。在店里时间会暂停。[/*]
[*][b]排班[/b]：客人是男性村民；你为每位客人指派一位女仆，没指派的由你（店长）亲自招待。[/*]
[*][b]演出[/b]：女仆会走到桌边，用气泡说话，台词随结果不同、也随人不同。[/*]
[*][b]四档评价[/b]：不满 / 普通 / 良好 / 优秀。不满很少见但会掉钱；良好与优秀有概率拿到客人送的回礼（按原版喜好表挑）。[/*]
[*][b]自己做饮料[/b]：造一台[b]调饮机[/b]（木材 30 + 石头 20 + 黏土 5 + 铜锭 1），投 [b]5 个咖啡豆[/b]进去出[b]5 杯咖啡[/b]；茶叶同理出绿茶。两种饮品各自带一点小增益。[/*]
[*][b]备货与点单[/b]：吧台的货架是[b]20 格储物箱[/b]，把做好的饮品（或一瓶果酒）放进去，[b]一格一件[/b]。满意的客人会点单 —— 他优先点自己爱喝的，所以备对货是真金白银；备酒还会让客人更放得开。[/*]
[*][b]酒[/b]：果酒是有正经名字的真瓶（蓝莓果酒、蜂蜜酒、淡啤酒…），未成年人永远不上，喝过酒的客人更容易提出"多留一会儿"。[/*]
[*][b]加钟 / 身份变体[/b]：特别满意的客人会提出让女仆再留一会儿。[b]成人向关闭[/b]时，每位女仆都有自己的做法 —— 茶叙、看星星、拍照、教一遍、收尾……钱、体力、带回东西的概率各不相同；最小的女仆贾斯是干净的「陪玩」：她在店里陪客人玩，不赚钱也不累。[/*]
[*][b]技能[/b]：每位女仆三个技能，熟练度 4 / 7 / 10 各解锁一个；有的是服务向，有的是"她替你跑一晚"时的代理向。[/*]
[*][b]拒绝也不要紧[/b]：不答应就不答应，她自己会消化，结算里还有一句她的话 —— 店是你的。[/*]
[*][b]成长[/b]：女仆长熟练度、也长对你的好感；你和客人互相加好感。[/*]
[*][b]隐藏好感[/b]：每位女仆与每位客人之间都有看不见的熟悉度；熟客会更常来，而且念着当时那位女仆。[/*]
[*][b]女仆手册[/b]：咖啡厅开业的第二天寄到你信箱（也能自己做）。拿在手上右键翻开：每人多少级、多少经验、体力、技能、服务过几次、跟谁最熟、谁一直在找她。[/*]
[/list][b]前置[/b]：星露谷 1.6.15、SMAPI 4.0+、Content Patcher 2.9+。 [b]可选[/b]：「模组设置菜单」（Generic Mod Config Menu）——装了能在游戏里直接调所有数值；[b]没装也能玩[/b]，改config.json效果一样。
[b]安装[/b]：把压缩包里的 MaidCafe、MaidCafe.Content、MaidCafe.MapPatch 一起解压到 Mods 文件夹。 [b]从 0.10.0 / 0.9.0 升级[/b]：直接覆盖即可，[b]存档兼容[/b] —— 旧货架上剩的东西第一次打开备货箱时会自动搬进新的 20 格库存，一件不丢。[b]已经建好咖啡厅的旧存档，会补发一次澜汐的开业启动包（含调饮机与调饮机配方）。[/b]
[b]语言[/b]：界面、配置与全部台词都是[b]中英双语[/b]，跟着游戏语言自动切换。
[b]说明[/b]：成人向内容[b]默认关闭[/b]，只做暧昧留白、不含露骨描写；未成年人（Vincent / Jas / Leo）在代码层面硬性排除。室内美术目前是占位版。[b]暧昧台词门槛现在是 4 心[/b]（旧版是 6 心）。 [b]老档提醒[/b]：你自己的 config.json 里还是旧数值 —— 游戏不会覆盖它，想用新默认请在 GMCM 里点「恢复默认」。
[b]三档头像[/b]（在模组设置里三选一，[b]默认「游戏原版风格」[/b]）：[b]①OhoDavi 风格[/b]（女仆装重绘 + 同一套客人，35 张）／[b]②游戏原版风格[/b]（我们改绘的原版系女仆 + 游戏原版客人）／[b]③跟随你装的美化[/b]（不换装，直接用你自己的村民头像）。两套图都由本模组自带，[b]不需要额外装任何前置[/b]；三档玩法完全相同，成人向氛围内容都在、默认关闭。
[b]致谢[/b]：①档的[b]女仆 13 张[/b]基于 [b]OhoDavi[/b] 的 [i]stardewvalley anime mods[/i]（[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Nexus 1839[/url]）[b]改绘[/b]、[b]客人 22 张是他的原作[/b]，按其授权条款「署名即可使用」注明出处；②档的女仆装是我们照[b]游戏原版头像[/b]改绘的，客人那 22 张是[b]游戏本体头像[/b]的裁图。
[b]报错请带上 SMAPI 日志[/b]（smapi.io/log），中文英文都可以。
